Name: Zebrus Automatic Lawn Robot (Lawnmower Bot)
Author: Zebruu
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/z24DJOg.png[/img]
[b]
[color=#ff7700]IMPORTANT: Players who prefer to cut grass manually or want a completely vanilla farming experience should check the settings. (Example: use invisible robots or thin out grass instead of removing it completely)[/color][/b][/center]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/BrI74tB.png[/img]﻿
[center][b][color=#38761d]Mod is available in English, German[/color]
[/b][/center]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/7SU3oCq.png[/img]
[center]New in 1.7.0[/center]
[center]-  Added a dedicated "System Control" Tab to the UI exclusively for Iridium Robots.[/center]
[center]- Implemented the [b]Fall Clear-Cut[/b] protocol. Requires a Rain Totem, Battery Pack, Linus (5 Hearts), and Maru (8 Hearts). When installed and active, the robot will automatically clear all remaining grass on the farm on Fall 28th. Thanks [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Kurachi84]@Kurachi84[/url] for the great idea[/center]
[center]-  Added the Dwarvish Interface Module. Requires 8 hearts with the Dwarf to unlock manual system overrides.[/center]
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/QlPIPNg.png[/img] [/center]
[center]---[/center]
[center]New in 1.6.0
- Added a configuration option to the Generic Mod Config Menu to switch the robot color between green and orange.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/VsmRXD7.png[/img]
---
New in 1.5.0
- Added the new Weed-Zapper Camera upgrade for the Iridium model requiring Glass Shards and a Rusty Spur.
- Enabled the robot to detect and destroy weeds blocking its path.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/N4pZr4i.png[/img]
- Added a new lifetime statistic to track the total amount of weeds removed by each station.
- Renamed the grass destroyed statistic to grass mowed for better clarity.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/k6PUuEa.png[/img]
---
New in 1.4.0
- Added the Diamond Blades upgrade for the Iridium model to preserve the lowest grass stage for faster meadow regrowth.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/IGfywVV.png[/img]
- Implemented intelligent pathfinding so robots with Diamond Blades ignore tiles containing only stage 1 grass to prevent useless trips.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/M45bV4I.png[/img]
---
New in 1.3.0
- Expanded the interactive station menu with a dedicated upgrades page
- Added a new tire upgrade system for the Iridium model using the Rusty Cog artifact to significantly increase travel speed on empty tiles.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/LhNl4qf.png[/img]
---
New in 1.2.0
- Added an interactive statistics menu to the robot station that tracks trips, distance driven, hay produced, and grass destroyed.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/MEKWvKi.png[/img]
---
New in 1.1.0
- Added a visual green preview grid when holding a lawnmower to show its exact mowing radius before placement.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Yr4UHa0.png[/img]
- Rebalanced the crafting recipes by adding Battery Packs (normal 1, gold 3, iridium 5) to all tiers to better reflect mid-game and end-game costs.
---
New in 1.0.1
- Fixed a critical bug where Content Patcher tokens would not load if Generic Mod Config Menu was not installed.
- Fixed an issue where the lawnmower cutting sound was audible globally instead of using positional audio on the farm.
- Added customizable mowing times to the configuration menu to give the robot enough time to complete its daily path.
---
New in 1.0.0
- Initial release of the Zebrus Automatic Lawn Robot.
- Added three robot tiers (Normal, Gold, Iridium) with escalating mowing radiuses.
- Added automatic hourly mowing schedule with intelligent obstacle pathfinding.
- Added automated hay storage directly into available farm silos.
- Added GMCM support for customizing robot visibility and mowing style.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/B3OD6rM.png[/img]

Once placed, the garage acts as the center of the top row. The robot will mow the entire area directly below and in front of its station. Every in-game hour, it scans for grass, plans a smart path around obstacles (like sprinklers or fences), and stores the hay directly in your silos.

The robot mows all 'X' tiles. Higher tiers simply expand this grid further down and to the sides!

[b]How to get the Blueprints[/b]
[spoiler]
The blueprints are sent to you via mail by Misu based on your farm's capacity:
- Normal Robot: Recipe arrives in your mailbox after you build your 1st Silo.
- Gold Robot: Recipe arrives after you build your 2nd Silo.
- Iridium Robot: Recipe arrives after you build your 3rd Silo.[/spoiler]
[/center]

[center]Zebrus Quest Board adds craftable quest boards to your farm. For: Daily quest, Special orders and MR. Qi orders. Annoying running around and forgetting quests can be prevented with this! “Zebrus Quest Mod Board” extended to ALL external mods, that use the standard mechanics. In addition, a fish statue for the fish tank quest and a raccoon statue:﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42337]Zebrus Quest Board[/url]
Zebrus Birthday Board adds a craftable birthday board to your farm. Never miss a birthday again. Check out the statistics and let the board remind you of upcoming gifts:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43028]Zebrus Birthday Board[/url][/center]
